Hot Streak

Uncommon perk · Scoring bonus

A scoring play that is your second or later consecutive play without visiting the boneyard adds 5 points.

In-game card text

How it works

A scoring play gains +5 points for each copy when it is your second or later play in a row without visiting the boneyard.

  • The streak counts your own plays only; Rival's turns in between do not break it.
  • Drawing from the boneyard, using a Table Pass, or passing because the boneyard is empty resets the streak. So does the start of a new hand.
  • Your very first play after a reset never qualifies.

At a glance

RarityUncommon
TypeScoring bonus
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itUnlocked from the start of every career.
